explanation: He won battle after battle against larger fleets. At Myeongnyang in 1597 he beat a Japanese force of more than 100 ships with just 13 of his own.

claims.text: Admiral Yi Sun-sin used armoured turtle ships against Japanese fleets during the Japanese invasions of Korea in the 1590s.
Kim Yu-sin was a Silla general of the 600s, Gwanggaeto was a Goguryeo king around AD 400, and Jang Bogo was a maritime trader of the 800s.
At the Battle of Myeongnyang in 1597, Yi Sun-sin's 13 ships defeated a Japanese fleet of more than 100 ships.
